title: 'Go back in the house,' neighbour warned after fatal police shooting in Aurora
article: York Region Police officers continued to comb the area adjacent to Leslie Street and State Farm Way today in the wake of the shooting death of a 22-year-old man last night.
The Special Investigations Unit is investigating the death, which reportedly took place after a man, armed with a gun, was shot as he approached officers.
The SIU is mandated to investigate all police incidents that result on death or serious injury to civilians.
Today, just down Leslie, within sight of the investigation where six police cruisers, a police van and SUV were on scene, neighbour Anna Coliviras described her fear the night before.
"I heard two big shots and I called 911 and I told the officer I heard two shots," Ms Colivaris said.
"He (the officer) said, 'We got the person. We caught somebody. Don't go outside. Go back in the house.'"
She said she closed the door and stayed inside, but, earlier today, asked what had happened and was told a man had a gun, was trying to shoot and was shot by police.
